# Discuss in-product cap/upgrade flow
Date: 2026-08-31 | Duration: 31.219999313354492m

## Summary
The team is defining Free and Pro limits, pricing, billing, and enforcement. Pro users will have up to three projects, while Free users can have three users; Pro includes five million monthly events with automatic billing of $50 per additional million, and Free includes two million events before event ingestion is blocked. Existing customers remain on legacy pricing, while new organizations receive the new limits through a switch-flip rollout. Event Forwarder compatibility creates exceptions for unsupported data sources, and Free is not yet fully integrated into Orb. In-app banners and modals will warn users about event and seat limits, while Orb alerts may support sales and marketing outreach. Free AI usage will have organization-wide weekly limits, whereas Pro overages will be billed automatically, but AI pricing remains undecided. A CDN tracking bug over-reported events threefold and required a backfill of 339,000 usage events. Michael is leading backend plans and Orb synchronization, Guy is handling in-app enforcement, and Kai is assigned notification logic. Sales training and nurture campaigns are being prepared, with Pendo under consideration.

## Keywords
Usage limits, pricing plans, event forwarder, AI usage, in-app messaging, upsell flow

## Action Items

**Michael Knowlton**
Share current sandbox model and screenshots of new plan limits and upgrade modals with the team to aid understanding and training (05:00)
Confirm enforcement policy regarding blocking or alerting users when they hit event limits, particularly for the Free plan restrictions (11:20)
Investigate technical capability to pause or block event acceptance upon exceeding usage limits and verify handling of managed warehouse events (23:30)
Provide detailed answers regarding strictness of enforcement for event limits and AI usage limits to finalize policy and communication (29:35)
Continue progressing on AI usage limits billing integration aiming for launch alignment, while recognizing some risk of delay (20:55)

**Elyse Fox**
Review shared limits documentation in detail and prepare sales training materials related to in-app limit messaging and upgrade flow (06:30)
Collaborate with marketing to define upsell and nurture flows tied to Orb alerts triggered as usage thresholds are reached (10:20)

**Ashley Stirrup**
Coordinate with sales training team to incorporate limit and upgrade flow information and prepare related FAQs for effective communication (25:35)
Prepare messaging flows regarding user and event limits enforcement, including blocking beyond user limits and billing explanations for clarity (22:00)
